categories.main_business_segments: The company operates through three main business segments: (1) Brand Management and Services, focusing on sales, installation, and maintenance of various household appliances under the Kolin brand and related services; (2) Automotive Electronics Manufacturing, specializing in the development, manufacturing, and sales of automotive multimedia products, including rear-seat entertainment and ADAS systems; (3) Asset Activation, involving real estate sales, leasing, and logistics warehousing services, including development of smart green buildings and industrial parks.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages smart technology integration in household appliances to enhance usability and energy efficiency. Automotive electronics products are developed with advanced multimedia and ADAS technologies, emphasizing modular design and system integration. Manufacturing is conducted primarily through ODM/OEM models with key components sourced externally. Real estate development incorporates smart green building standards and 5G-enabled technology parks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include domestic consumers for household appliances, automotive manufacturers and technology companies for automotive electronics, and commercial tenants for real estate and logistics services. The household appliance segment mainly serves the Taiwan domestic market, while automotive electronics focus on export markets in Asia and beyond. The asset activation segment targets industrial and commercial clients in Taiwan and Shanghai.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, Malaysia (Penang), and China (Shanghai and Shenzhen). The household appliance business is primarily domestic in Taiwan. Automotive electronics manufacturing and R&D are based in Malaysia and Shenzhen, serving global automotive markets. The asset activation business operates in Taiwan and Shanghai, providing warehousing and real estate services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments. It designs and assembles automotive electronics products using externally sourced components, and sells branded household appliances sourced via OEM/ODM. The asset activation segment functions downstream as a real estate developer and logistics service provider. The company maintains close supplier relationships to ensure stable procurement.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include collaboration, innovation, carbon reduction, and sustainability. R&D focuses on smart and energy-efficient household appliances, advanced automotive infotainment and ADAS integration, and green building technologies. The company invests in AI and internet connectivity for automotive products and pursues digitalization to optimize internal processes and reduce environmental impact.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of household appliances and automotive electronics, service fees from installation and maintenance, leasing and sales of real estate properties, and logistics warehousing services. The company also benefits from asset appreciation and rental income from its property portfolio.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In household appliances, competitors include Tatung, Sampo, TECO, Chimei, and Sanyo. In automotive rear-seat entertainment, competitors include Kaei Optoelectronics and E-Lead Electronics. The company positions itself as a reputable Taiwanese brand with a strong legacy, leveraging innovation and integrated services to maintain competitiveness against international and regional players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.5 billion in 2024, a 63% increase from the previous year, with net profit rising by 69%. It has a solid asset base exceeding NT$4.6 billion and equity of over NT$3 billion. The company shows a stable growth trajectory supported by real estate development completions and expanding automotive electronics sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes trusted brand heritage, integrated sales and after-sales service, and smart technology application to enhance user convenience and energy efficiency in household appliances. In automotive electronics, it differentiates through advanced ADAS integration, modular design, and close collaboration with customers and technology partners. Its asset activation segment offers high-quality, green-certified industrial and office spaces, reinforcing its commitment to innovation and sustainability.
